prompt:
A full-body vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) character card image of an adult Japanese woman — the personification of the city of Tokyo — one woman who IS Tokyo as it stands in this world. She is the subject of the picture; her costume, body, props and light carry the city's symbols and this world's marks, and the city behind her only supports her.

1. STYLE
Korean MMORPG character artwork. A painterly face with naturally observed facial anatomy, subtle eyelid structure, and soft, realistic shading across the nose and cheeks. 2D painting with visible brushwork: layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, thin coloured linework and a few crisp accents on the face and costume.
She is strikingly beautiful and refined — harmonious features, clear luminous skin, graceful posture — while her own face stays distinct: her face shape, eyes, brows, nose and lips follow the description below, not a generic pretty face.
Face proportions: Her face is small and soft: a short midface, a softly rounded jaw and a small chin, about 1.3 times as long as it is wide, with her eyes open at their natural size. Bangs, side locks and headpieces frame the face without lengthening it.

2. CHARACTER
Age: about twenty — a fresh young-adult face; no facial lines.
Face — her own: an elegant, refined presence; fair skin; face with soft jaw angles that taper gently toward a rounded chin, not wide from the front; soft almond eyes with gently lowered outer corners; pale violet eyes; gently arched, slender brows; a straight nose with a slim bridge; lips with a defined cupid's bow, of natural size.
Skin finish: dewy, glass-like highlights on the skin of her shoulders, arms, collarbones and legs — a soft, luminous wet-look sheen that follows the body's forms; her face keeps a soft, natural finish.
Body and hair: hourglass-figured — full bust and hips, distinctly narrow-waisted build; a side-parted chin-length graduated bob with one side tucked neatly behind her ear; sunset-pink hair.
Expression: a reserved, thoughtful expression with lips gently closed.
Anatomy: one head, two arms and two legs, each joined at its natural joint; natural hands with five fingers.

3. COSTUME — CYBERPUNK
Costume: techwear for a neon megacity — a sleek reflective coat or cropped jacket over fitted technical layers, straps and buckles, chrome and glossy vinyl, glowing tattoo lines and cybernetic implants on her skin, holographic jewelry; sign light reflected on her face and coat.
Costume silhouette: a long coat slung off one shoulder, a wide sash belt and a sheath-like device on her back — an asymmetric street-samurai silhouette.
Design idea: An upper vermilion crossbar and a lower ivory crossbar form a double bridge across the offset shoulder opening, with two upright collar stays shaped like a torii gate.
City motif: light strips running over her fitted coat and bodysuit in the crisscross pattern of the city's old red-and-white lattice tower, glowing vermilion and white, with digital cherry petals drifting around her and dissolving into light.
World marks on her: glowing neon tattoos; cybernetic implants; a sleek reflective long coat; sign light reflected on her face; holographic jewelry; fiber-optic glowing hair strands; chrome and glossy vinyl; magenta and cyan glow; soft holographic light shimmering across her skin and coat; techwear traced with glowing light lines; far-future smart fabric rippling with soft light patterns.
Colours: tower vermilion, ginkgo yellow, cherry-blossom pink — one of these as her accent colour.
Prop: in one hand she holds a holographic folding fan whose ribs of light open into a spray of drifting digital cherry petals; her other hand is free.
Exposure (bold): her techwear opens to show skin — a cropped top under the open reflective coat with natural cleavage, bare midriff and shoulders traced with glowing tattoo lines, high-cut shorts or a slit skirt over strapped thigh-high boots. Intimate areas covered.

4. SCENE
World: Tokyo Bay two centuries from now, a far-future megacity on the water: arcology islands of sleek curved towers floating on the bay, linked by glowing maglev rings that loop between them; the Shibuya scramble crossing rebuilt as a stack of circular plazas of light, crowds flowing across every level at once; giant holographic torii gates and drifting cherry-blossom holograms hanging in the sky; the tall broadcasting spire by the river reborn as a pillar-of-light tower shining straight up into the clouds; flying vehicles moving in quiet lanes of light under a clear night sky.
This card: on the top tier of the stacked plazas of light rebuilt over the Shibuya scramble crossing, crowds streaming across the glowing levels below her and cherry-blossom holograms drifting overhead.
Pose: standing confidently, her body turned slightly while her face looks toward the viewer.
Stance and hands: She holds her opened fan at waist level to one side and lets the fingers of her free hand rest lightly against the sash.
Setting detail: The circular plaza rail curves away behind her, with its lower tiers softly lit.
Light: a soft key light with a strong rim light tracing her hair, shoulders and armour; bright, crisp specular highlights on metal and jewellery, and a clean, warm-neutral sheen on her skin.
Composition: vertical 2:3 full-body framing with modest headroom and clear space below the boots — the whole figure from the top of her head or headpiece to both feet stays inside the frame, occupying about four-fifths of the image height, with the same camera distance in every world; her hands stay inside the frame. Camera level with her face with natural portrait perspective; her head level, chin neither raised nor tucked — no upward perspective on her face, no wide-angle distortion, no low angle, no close crop.

5. CONSTRAINTS
One figure only; no text, lettering or numbers anywhere in the picture; no logo or watermark.
Avoid: second character, living creature, logo, watermark, speech bubble, frame border, text, lettering, numbers anywhere in the picture, a blue or bruise-like tint on the skin around the eyes, glossy or shiny highlights on the face, sweaty, oily or plastic-looking skin.
